7 Brew Cocoberry Lemonade: Price, Calories & Caffeine

A medium Cocoberry Lemonade is about $3.50, with 280 calories, 0 mg of caffeine and 68 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Is there a sugar-free Cocoberry Lemonade?

Yes — 7 Brew lists a sugar-free version built with sugar-free syrups. Comparing mediums (iced):

VersionCaloriesSugarCarbsCaffeine
Cocoberry Lemonade28068 g69 g0 mg
Sugar-free Cocoberry Lemonade19045 g47 g0 mg

Caffeine does not change — only the syrup does. See every sugar-free option in the customization guide.

Cocoberry Lemonade allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists no declared allergens for the standard Cocoberry Lemonade. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Cocoberry Lemonade

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Cocoberry Lemonade?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

Make a Cocoberry Lemonade at Home

Start with lemonade, then the two syrups. This is one of the easier copycats because the base does most of the work.

For one large glass

  • 1 1/2 cups lemonade (your own batch or a good bottled one)
  • 1 tablespoon coconut syrup
  • 1 tablespoon raspberry syrup
  • A full cup of ice
  1. Syrups in the glass first, lemonade over them.
  2. Stir, then ice. Or ice, then stir. This drink is not precious.
  3. Taste for the balance: raspberry should bite first, coconut should round it off.

Sugar-free attempt: sugar-free versions of both syrups get you the flavor swap, but with regular lemonade underneath you will land where the stand does: lower, not zero. A truly zero version needs a sugar-free lemonade base too, and then it is your drink, not theirs.

7 Brew Cocoberry Lemonade FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Cocoberry Lemonade?

A medium iced Cocoberry Lemonade has 280 calories. A small has 210 and a large 420, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Cocoberry Lemonade?

0 mg. No lemonade carries caffeine unless tea or energy gets mixed in.

How much does a 7 Brew Cocoberry Lemonade cost?

Roughly $2.75 for a small, $3.50 for a medium and $4.25 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Cocoberry Lemonade?

68 g in a medium, or 45 g if you order the sugar-free version.

Why does the sugar-free Cocoberry still have 45 g of sugar?

Because sugar-free describes the syrups, not the drink. The coconut and raspberry flavorings swap to sugar-free versions, but they sit on the regular lemonade base, and that base is sweetened before anything gets added. So a medium Sugar-Free Cocoberry lands at 190 calories and 45 g of sugar, down from 280 and 68. A real saving, just not zero. Oddly, no guide in the top results prints that 190 and 45 figure at all. One calls the sugar-free version much lower calorie and leaves it there. 7 Brew's own fine print is more honest than most of its fan pages: a drink built with sugar-free flavors may not be sugar-free overall. More traps like this one are tracked on our sugar-free page.

Iced, frozen chiller or lemon freeze: what changes?

More than the texture. Iced is the drink in the table above: 280 calories in a medium. The Frozen Chiller build is a different animal at 630 calories and 153 g of sugar for the same size, because the frozen base is far sweeter. The Lemon Freeze is the dessert format, creamier still. Same name on the board, three different drinks on paper. If you are counting anything, the word iced is the most important word in your order.

Is there coconut cream or milk in a Cocoberry Lemonade?

No. The official line calls it creamy coconut, and that word creamy is doing flavor work, not ingredient work. The standard build is coconut and raspberry flavoring in lemonade, and the guide lists 0 g of fat for it. Cream, whipped cream and cold foam are toppings you can add, and they suit it. But the drink in the nutrition table has no dairy in it.

Why do other sites say 140 calories, or 600, for a medium?

Because almost nobody is reading the same drink the same way. One deep guide puts a medium at 140 to 240 calories, well under the guide. Another puts the medium iced at 300 to 600, which quietly folds the frozen builds into an iced label. The official guide says 280 calories and 68 g of sugar for a medium iced, 210 for a small, 420 for a large. Those are the numbers in the table above.

Is Cocoberry a good pick for kids?

On caffeine, yes, there is none. On sugar, go in with open eyes: even the kids size carries 39 g, and a medium has 68 g. The sugar-free version at 45 g in a medium, or a half-sweet regular, keeps the coconut-raspberry flavor without the full load. It is a treat drink. Ordered like one, it is a great one.
